PROJECTS ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Project - 1 Technologies : Java, Angular, SQL, Spring boot, Hibarnet

Title : Cad Application

Role & Responsibilities:

Developed and maintained RESTful APIs using Spring Boot Microservices for event creation and

dispatch workflows.

Built responsive UI components with Angular 15 to support real-time dashboard updates and

dispatcher interfaces

Implemented unit testing using JUnit 5 to ensure backend reliability and reduce bugs.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, scalable web solutions. Followed clean code practices and used tools like SonarQube to maintain code quality.

Description : RESPOND is a Computer-Aided Dispatch (CAD) application built to reduce crime and enable rapid response across the city. When a citizen calls 112 (police emergency number), the call is registered as an event in the system. This event is then dispatched by a controller, who assigns a First Responder (vehicle) to the location for immediate action including call volumes and response status.

Project -2 Title : Dashboard Technologies : Java, Angular, Sql, Spring boot, Hibarnate : Roles

Using Spring Boot and Angular to handle call data and vehicle records. Built dynamic UI components in Angular to display call summaries and incident mappings. Integrated database queries with MySQL to retrieve and manage call logs. Collaborated with a cross-functional team to enhance system reliability and ensure accurate data

validation.

Description: The Dashboard is a web application developed to monitor and manage records of

incoming calls received in the system. It helps categorize calls into types such as Blank Call, Crank Call, and Missed Call. The application also supports vehicle onboarding and cross-verification of calls with registered incident cases for better case tracking and validation.
